يتطارحوا (form VI)
# يَتَطَارَحُوا (yataṭāraḥū) /ja.ta.tˤaː.ra.ħuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَطَارَحَ (taṭāraḥa)
# يُتَطَارَحُوا (yutaṭāraḥū) /ju.ta.tˤaː.ra.ħuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَطَارَحَ (taṭāraḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
